description: Intrusion with deliberate false flag. The attacker left traces designed to attribute the attack to a known Russian APT group. VIGÍA must detect the incoherence of intent.

forensic_anomalies: mimikatz.exe on a Linux server — the binary does not run on Linux without Wine, it was never actually executed
history -c at the end but the file exists — contradiction: if you cleared history, how does this file exist?
The Russian comment 'Задание выполнено' (mission accomplished) is too cinematic — real operators do not comment their commands
wget from GitHub with exact release URL — an APT would use its own infrastructure, not public GitHub
MD5 d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e is the hash of an EMPTY file — no real exfiltration occurred
created == modified with exact-second precision — manipulated timestamps
Permissions 0644 on a supposedly secret exfiltration file — a real operator would use 0600
